page_topic_one_liner: AI agent memory layer — persistent cross-session middleware with write/store/retrieve, vectors, temporal graphs, and scoped retrieval beyond million-token context windows
differentiator_vs_generic: This is developer infrastructure for agent persistence and selective recall — NOT consumer PKM, NOT platform chat memory, NOT generic brain icon. Hero must show external memory store feeding a slim context window via retrieval arrows.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Agent runtime diagram — compact context window on left, external memory substrate on right (vector nodes + temporal graph edges), accent klein-blue arrows for write path (dialogue → store) and retrieve path (store → injected context chips)
Secondary: bloated full-history context bar crossed out vs lean working-set with 3-4 retrieved memory chips highlighted
Tertiary: scoped tenant bubbles (user/session/agent/team) around memory partitions — governance visual
anti_patterns: Generic brain or lightbulb as hero
LLM chat panel as hero (this is memory middleware not conversation UI)
Consumer note-taking app (Notion/Evernote style) as main visual
Empty database icon without retrieval flow
